title: OpenAI’s WebRTC problem
summary: This article discusses the technical challenges and problems with OpenAI's implementation of WebRTC (Web Real-Time Communication) for real-time AI interactions. The author from moq.dev analyzes specific issues related to latency, connection management, and protocol handling in AI real-time applications.
problem_solved: Addresses the technical challenges and architectural problems when implementing WebRTC for OpenAI's real-time AI streaming applications.
why_valuable: Provides deep technical insights into real-time communication implementation pitfalls that affect AI application performance and user experience.
